details.s: Théoden, son of Thengel and Morwen Steelsheen, was the seventeenth King of Rohan, last of the Second Line of the royal House of Eorl.
f: King of Rohan, Lord of the Mark, Horsemaster, Father of Horse-men
March 15, 3019 (aged 71), Battle of the Pelennor Fields
